AND COMPANY_ID = #{companyId}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalApplications, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LEASE_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'APPROVED') THEN LEASE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outstandingAmount, COALESCE(AVG(INTEREST_RATE), 0) AS averageRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LEASE_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN LEASE_STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) ELSE 0 END AS approvalRate FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_LEASE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT LEASE_TYPE AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_LEASE WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY LEASE_TYPE ORDER BY value DESC
